title: Describing Interventions So Others Can Repeat Them (TIDieR)

hook.en: A trial says "exercise reduced pain". Which exercise? How many sets, how often, who supervised, and how was it progressed? Without these details, no therapist can repeat it, and the trial is almost useless in the clinic. TIDieR is the checklist that fixes this.
hook.ur: Trial kehta hai "exercise ne dard kam kiya". Kaun si exercise? Kitne sets, kitni baar, kis ki nigrani mein, aur progression kaise hui? In tafseelat ke baghair koi therapist isay dohra nahi sakta, aur trial clinic mein taqreeban bekaar hai. TIDieR woh checklist hai jo isay theek karti hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll use the 12-item TIDieR checklist to describe an intervention, spot poorly described treatments in papers, and write an intervention description that another therapist could follow.
goal.ur: End tak aap 12 items wali TIDieR checklist se intervention bayan karenge, papers mein kam tafseel wale ilaaj pehchanenge, aur aisi intervention ki tafseel likhenge jis par doosra therapist chal sake.

text.en: Many trials fail to describe the treatment well enough to repeat it. Reviews have found that more than half of published trial interventions were incompletely described. **TIDieR** (Template for Intervention Description and Replication) has 12 items: **brief name, why** (rationale), **what** (materials and procedures), **who provided**, **how** (mode), **where**, **when and how much** (dose), **tailoring**, **modifications**, and how well it was planned and delivered (**fidelity**). The idea is that a clinician could read your description and deliver the same intervention.
text.ur: Bohat se trials ilaaj ko itni tafseel se bayan nahi karte ke dohraya ja sake. Reviews ne paya ke shaya shuda trial interventions ke aadhe se zyada ki tafseel adhoori thi. **TIDieR** (Template for Intervention Description and Replication) ke 12 items hain: **mukhtasar naam, kyun** (wajah), **kya** (saman aur tareeqa), **kis ne diya**, **kaise** (tareeqa), **kahan**, **kab aur kitna** (dose), **tailoring**, **tabdeeliyan**, aur kitni achhi tarah plan aur deliver hua (**fidelity**). Khayal yeh hai ke clinician aap ki tafseel parh kar wahi intervention de sake.

text.en: Think of **a recipe for biryani**. "Cook rice with meat" is not a recipe. A real recipe lists ingredients, quantities, timings, the pot, who cooks it and what to adjust if the rice is old. TIDieR is the biryani recipe for a therapy: complete enough that someone else could make it taste the same.
text.ur: **Biryani ki recipe** sochein. "Chawal gosht ke saath pakayein" recipe nahi. Asal recipe ajzaa, miqdar, waqt, deg, pakane wale aur agar chawal purane hon to kya badlein sab batati hai. TIDieR therapy ki biryani recipe hai: itni mukammal ke koi doosra wahi zayqa bana sake.

title.ur: TIDieR ko likhne ki checklist ke taur par

steps.title: Name it and say why
steps.detail: Give the intervention a brief name and explain the theory or rationale: why do you expect it to work? || Naam dein aur wajah batayein

steps.title: Describe what, who, how and where
steps.detail: List materials (leaflets, equipment), each procedure, who delivered it (and their training), whether it was face to face or remote, and where. || Kya, kaun, kaise aur kahan bayan karein

steps.title: Give the dose
steps.detail: How many sessions, how often, how long each, over how many weeks, and what the intensity was. || Dose batayein

steps.title: Explain tailoring and changes
steps.detail: Was the programme the same for everyone or adjusted to each person? Did it change during the study? || Tailoring aur tabdeeliyan batayein

steps.title: Report fidelity
steps.detail: How was adherence assessed, and how well was the plan delivered? Report the proportion of sessions attended and any deviations. || Fidelity report karein

question.en: A paper states that the treatment group received "physiotherapy exercises". Which TIDieR items are clearly missing?
question.ur: Paper kehta hai ke ilaaj group ko "physiotherapy exercises" di gayin. TIDieR ke kaun se items saaf taur par ghayab hain?

feedback.en: The description is far too vague.
The deeper problem is lack of detail.
feedback.ur: Gehra masla tafseel ki kami hai.

text.en: What (which exercises), who delivered, how much (dose), and fidelity
text.ur: Kya (kaun si exercises), kis ne diya, kitna (dose), aur fidelity

feedback.ur: Haan — "physiotherapy exercises" dohrayi nahi ja sakti.

question.ur: TIDieR mein "tailoring" ka kya matlab hai?

text.en: Whether and how the intervention was adjusted to each participant, for example by starting load or progression
text.ur: Intervention har shirkat karne wale ke liye kaise dhali gayi, ya nahi, masalan shuruaati load ya progression se

feedback.en: Yes — most rehab is individualised, and readers need to know how.
feedback.ur: Haan — zyada tar rehab infiradi hoti hai, aur parhne walon ko jaanna hai kaise.

question.en: Why does fidelity matter when you read a trial?
question.ur: Trial parhte waqt fidelity kyun ahem hai?

text.en: It is only about the cost
text.ur: Yeh sirf kharch ke baare mein hai

feedback.en: Fidelity is about delivery and adherence.
feedback.ur: Fidelity delivery aur pairavi ke baare mein hai.

text.en: If the intervention was poorly delivered or attended, a negative result may reflect poor delivery rather than an ineffective treatment
text.ur: Agar intervention kharab tareeqe se di gayi ya hazri kam thi to manfi nateeja be-asar ilaaj ke bajaye kharab delivery ki wajah ho sakta hai

feedback.en: Yes — we need to know whether the treatment was actually given.
feedback.ur: Haan — hamein jaanna hai ke ilaaj asal mein diya gaya ya nahi.

text.en: **Describing the idea but not the dose.** "Strengthening exercises were prescribed" leaves out the load, the number of repetitions, how often, and how they progressed. The dose, with the tailoring, is what a therapist needs to copy it. Another trap is describing the experimental treatment in detail and the comparison treatment vaguely ("usual care"). Describe both.
text.ur: **Khayal bayan karna lekin dose nahi.** "Strengthening exercises tajweez ki gayin" mein load, repetitions ki ginti, kitni baar, aur progression kaise hui sab chhoot jata hai. Dose, tailoring ke saath, woh hai jo therapist ko copy karne ke liye chahiye. Ek aur jaal tajrabati ilaaj ko tafseel se aur comparison ilaaj ko mubham ("usual care") bayan karna hai. Dono bayan karein.

text.en: **Write your own treatments down.** When you develop a new exercise sheet or protocol in your clinic, write it as a TIDieR table. It becomes a handout for new staff, a basis for audit, and the start of a paper. Use pictures and a simple dose table for patients, and keep a version history.
text.ur: **Apne ilaaj likh kar rakhein.** Jab aap apne clinic mein nayi exercise sheet ya protocol banate hain to isay TIDieR table ki shakl mein likhein. Yeh naye staff ke liye handout, audit ki bunyad aur paper ki shuruaat ban jata hai. Mareezon ke liye tasveerein aur saada dose table istemal karein, aur version history rakhein.

question.en: Is "usual care" a good enough description for a comparison group?
question.ur: Kya "usual care" comparison group ke liye kaafi tafseel hai?

answer.en: Rarely. Usual care varies enormously between clinics, from nothing to good-quality rehab. If it is not described, we cannot tell whether a new treatment beat a weak comparison or a strong one. Good trials describe usual care with TIDieR too: what it included, how much, and who delivered it, ideally measured rather than assumed.
answer.ur: Shayad hi. Usual care clinics mein bohat mukhtalif hoti hai, kuch nahi se le kar achhi quality ki rehab tak. Agar bayan na ho to hum nahi jaan sakte ke naya ilaaj kamzor comparison ko haraya ya mazboot ko. Achhe trials usual care ko bhi TIDieR se bayan karte hain: is mein kya tha, kitna, aur kis ne diya, behtar hai ke naapa gaya ho, farz nahi.

beats.patient: A therapist wants to repeat a trial that reported "Pilates-based exercise improved low back pain". She finds the paper says only that participants did "Pilates" for eight weeks.
beats.assessment: The paper does not say how many sessions per week, how long, who taught, what exercises or how they progressed.
beats.treatment: She emails the authors for the programme manual, and when planning her own study uses a TIDieR table to record each item.
beats.reassess: Her own paper includes a full TIDieR table as a supplement, and a colleague repeats the programme in another city.

text.en: **Describe safety precautions and exclusions.** A treatment cannot be repeated safely without knowing who was excluded, what precautions were used and how adverse events were handled. Report them as part of the intervention description. Do not copy a published protocol into a patient group very different from the trial's.
text.ur: **Safety ehtiyaten aur exclusions bayan karein.** Ilaaj ko mehfooz tareeqe se dohraya nahi ja sakta agar yeh na maloom ho ke kis ko khaarij kiya gaya, kaun si ehtiyaten bartin gayin aur adverse events kaise sambhale gaye. In ko intervention ki tafseel ka hissa bana kar report karein. Shaya shuda protocol aise mareezon mein na copy karein jo trial se bohat mukhtalif hon.

text.en: Hoffmann and colleagues developed the TIDieR checklist and guide by expert consensus, to improve the completeness of reporting of interventions and make replication possible. Glasziou and colleagues showed that a large share of biomedical research reports are incomplete or unusable, including intervention descriptions, which contributes to avoidable waste in research and makes it hard for clinicians to apply findings.
text.ur: Hoffmann aur saathiyon ne TIDieR checklist aur guide maahireen ke ittefaq se banayi, taake interventions ki report ki mukammaliat behtar ho aur dohrana mumkin ho. Glasziou aur saathiyon ne dikhaya ke biomedical research reports ka bara hissa adhoora ya na-qabil-e-istemal hai, intervention ki tafseel samet, jo research mein bachne ke qabil zaya mein hissa daalta hai aur clinicians ke liye findings lagu karna mushkil banata hai.

text.en: **Name, Why, What, Who, Where, When-how-much, Tailor, Fidelity.** The core of TIDieR, in the order you would write it.
text.ur: **Naam, Kyun, Kya, Kaun, Kahan, Kab-kitna, Tailor, Fidelity.** TIDieR ka maghz, usi tarteeb mein jis mein aap likhte.

summary.en: TIDieR's 12 items let readers repeat an intervention: name, why, what, who, how, where, dose, tailoring, changes and fidelity.
summary.ur: TIDieR ke 12 items parhne walon ko intervention dohrane dete hain: naam, kyun, kya, kaun, kaise, kahan, dose, tailoring, tabdeeliyan aur fidelity.

summary.en: Always report the dose and describe the comparison treatment as well as the experimental one.
summary.ur: Hamesha dose report karein aur comparison ilaaj ko bhi tajrabati ilaaj ki tarah bayan karein.

summary.en: Write your own clinic protocols with TIDieR and include safety precautions and exclusions.
summary.ur: Apne clinic protocols TIDieR se likhein aur safety ehtiyaten aur exclusions shamil karein.
